meta.title: Maison Vault | Luxury Bags, Watches & Jewellery
meta.description: Curated bags from Hermès, Louis Vuitton and Chanel, watches from Rolex and Patek Philippe and jewellery from Van Cleef & Arpels – inspected, shipped insured, personally advised.

hero.title: Bags, Timepieces & Jewellery
hero.subtitle: Curated masterpieces from the great Maisons – inspected, documented and personally selected for you.

about.title: We are Maison Vault
about.teaser: We buy and sell selected bags, watches and jewellery from the most renowned houses. Independent, international and with a service that goes one step further.
about.body: Every piece is carefully inspected by specialists before sale: condition, materials, serial numbers and documents. If we cannot place an item beyond doubt, we do not take it on.

values.title: Careful inspection
values.text: Every object is examined by specialists before listing and described transparently.

values.title: Discretion
values.text: Buying, selling and advice are handled confidentially – privately, without public listing, on request.

values.title: Personal service
values.text: One dedicated contact accompanies you – from the search to insured delivery.

sellCta.title: Sell your luxury piece
sellCta.text: We value your bag, watch or jewellery free of charge and take care of presentation, inspection and insured shipping.

items.title: Expert inspection
items.text: Condition, materials and documents examined before every sale.

items.title: Insured shipping
items.text: Tracking, value insurance and proof of delivery.

items.title: Secure payment
items.text: Bank transfer or vetted payment providers – we never store card data.

items.title: Personal advice
items.text: By phone, via WhatsApp or by appointment.

story.title: Your signature piece
story.text: For many it starts with an image you never forget: the first Kelly, the dial of a Nautilus, the glow of an Alhambra motif. We know how special the moment is when a wish becomes yours – and we also search on your behalf.
story.social: Follow us for new pieces and insights.

journal.title: Journal
journal.intro: News, care advice and background stories from the world of the great Maisons.

footer.demoNotice: Demo version: items, prices and photos are placeholders.

contactPage.title: We are here for you
contactPage.text: Write to us about a specific item, a search request or a sale. We usually reply within one business day.
